transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having pain in my left flank. It's been going on for about four or five days now, and it's making me feel quite sick.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
No, I haven't had any bad reactions to medicines that I know of.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is the pain in your left flank?

I'm not sure I can put a number on it exactly, but it's a bad pain — enough that I've been feeling sick with it and it's hard to get comfortable. It's been there steadily for the last four or five days.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take, including any new or changed ones and the doses if you know them?
I'm not on any regular medicines that I can think of. Nothing new or changed recently, as far as I know.
Do you have any health problems that you've had for a long time?
Another doctor told me I have a stone, about 1.3 centimeters, in the left ureter — the tube from the kidney. That's really the main thing I'm dealing with right now.
Is there anything you’ve noticed that makes the pain better or worse?
I haven't really noticed anything that makes it better or worse. It just seems to be there most of the time.
Aside from feeling quite sick, is there anything else you’d like to add?
Well, I have been feeling nauseous and I've been vomiting with it. I haven't noticed any blood in my urine, and it doesn't hurt or burn when I pass urine, and I haven't had any fevers.
What, if anything, worries you most about what's going on?
What worries me most is this stone. I'd really like to get something done about it.
Could you describe what the pain in your left side actually feels like?
It's a steady, aching sort of pain in my left side — it goes through my abdomen and around across my back. It doesn't really come and go; it's just there.
Have you had any other health conditions, operations, or hospital stays in the past that you haven't mentioned yet?
No, there's nothing else I can think of. The stone in the left ureter is the only thing that's been going on.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about medicines — anything at all, even something you only take once in a while?
No, nothing else. I don't take anything, not even now and then.
Is there anything else you've noticed going on with your body that we haven't talked about yet?
No, I don't think so. The pain in my left side, the nausea and vomiting — that's really it.
How would you describe the pain in your left side — is it mild, moderate, or severe, or are you not sure?
I'd say it's on the severe side, honestly. It's bad enough to make me feel sick, but I can't give you an exact number.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
